svg.title: How the weights are stored on disk
svg.desc: The folder has 5 carried files of 18 GB and 43 layer files of 2.05 GB. One layer file holds 216 experts of 9.47 MB. One expert is 12 tensors: w1, w2 and w3, each with trellis, suh, svh and mcg.
svg.text: data/tp1: 48 tensor files, drawn to scale (about 106 GB)
43 files exl3-layer-{L}-tp1-rank0.safetensors, 2.05 GB each: the routed experts
one layer file: 216 experts × 9.47 MB = 2.05 GB
one expert: 3 matrices × 4 tensors = 12 tensors, 25.2 M parameters, 9.47 MB at 3.0 bpw
carried files: attention, shared experts, router, embeddings, head (FP8 / BF16, about 7 B parameters)
